start.title: The Walls of Jericho
start.text:
The city stands shut and silent.
Its walls swallow the horizon.

choices.text: Charge the gates with full force
choices.feedback: These walls will not yield to swords.

choices.text: Lay siege and starve them out
choices.feedback: The Lord has another way.
Joshua 6:2 — The Lord had already given Jericho into Joshua's hand.

charge_consequence.title: Not by Might
charge_consequence.text:
These stones laugh at sword and spear.
Seek His word first.

choices.feedback: You lower your blade.

siege_consequence.title: His Plan, Not Yours
siege_consequence.text:
Hunger is no weapon of faith.
Kneel and ask Him.

choices.feedback: You step away from the war camp.

divine_word.title: "I Have Given It Into Your Hand"
divine_word.text:
March around the city six days.
On the seventh, march seven times.

choices.feedback: His ways are not your ways.
Joshua 6:2-5 — Joshua received the Lord's specific instructions for taking Jericho.

argue_consequence.title: Faith, Not Reason
argue_consequence.text:
His command may seem strange.
Obedience is your part.

choices.feedback: Your heart settles in trust.

instruct_priests.title: Take Up the Trumpets
instruct_priests.text:
Seven priests, seven horns of ram.
The ark goes before the people.

choices.text: Hide the ark behind the warriors
choices.feedback: His presence must lead, not follow.

choices.text: Send priests in the rear for safety
choices.feedback: Faith walks in front, not behind.

choices.text: Place the priests at the front
choices.feedback: Joshua 6:6 — Joshua commanded the priests to take up the ark of the covenant and seven trumpets.

hide_consequence.title: Let Him Lead
hide_consequence.text:
His presence is your only banner.
Lift it high before all eyes.

choices.text: Place the priests at the front
choices.feedback: The procession forms behind the ark.

rear_consequence.title: Faith Walks First
rear_consequence.text:
If He goes before, who can stand?
Let the trumpets lead.

choices.text: Place the priests at the front
choices.feedback: The horns lift in trembling hands.

first_march.title: The First Circle
first_march.text:
Only trumpets break the silence.
Jericho mocks from the walls.

choices.feedback: Not yet. Hold your voice.
Joshua 6:10 — Joshua commanded the people not to shout or make any noise until the day he told them to shout.

shout_consequence.title: Wait for His Signal
shout_consequence.text:
Your voice must wait six more days.
Let the horns alone speak.

choices.feedback: You close your lips and march.

sixth_day.title: Six Days Have Passed
sixth_day.text:
The people grow weary, doubting.
Tomorrow is the seventh.

choices.feedback: His promise stands. Hold the line.

choices.text: Encourage them to trust one more day
choices.feedback: Joshua 6:14 — On the sixth day, the army marched around the city once, just as they had done on the previous days.

quit_consequence.title: His Word Does Not Fail
quit_consequence.text:
Six days obeyed are not wasted.
Finish what He began.

choices.text: Encourage them to trust one more day
choices.feedback: Hope returns to weary faces.

seventh_day.title: Seven Times Around
seventh_day.text:
The horns blow. The dust rises.
The seventh circle is complete.

choices.feedback: The moment He named has come.
Joshua 6:16 — After the seventh time around on the seventh day, Joshua commanded the people to shout, for the Lord had given them the city.

wait_consequence.title: Now Is the Hour
wait_consequence.text:
He has set this very moment.
Lift your voice without fear.

choices.feedback: The cry rises from every throat.

walls_fall.title: The Walls Tremble
walls_fall.text:
Stones crack. Towers lean.
Jericho falls into its own dust.

choices.feedback: Not your hand. His.

choices.text: Give all glory to the Lord
choices.feedback: Joshua 6:20 — The people shouted, and the walls of Jericho fell flat, and they took the city.

boast_consequence.title: His Victory, Not Yours
boast_consequence.text:
No sword struck these walls.
Lift your eyes, not your name.

choices.text: Give all glory to the Lord
choices.feedback: You bow your head in the dust.

ending_obedient.title: Into the City
ending_obedient.text:
The Lord has given Jericho.
Faith walked where strength could not.
